2105-7297-7431-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-7297-7431-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-7297-7431-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Daydream from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Daydream from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

280-2645-3430-5475.easyPrerequisites: Forensic Researcher doesn't have summoning sickness.
280-2645-3430-5475.description:
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Golgari Rot Farm
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

671-1339-1832-4050.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
671-1339-1832-4050.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding one mana of any color
When the Insect dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1870-2734-4873-5087.easyPrerequisites: Darksteel Reactor and Eternity Vessel have at least twenty charge counters combined.
1870-2734-4873-5087.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
1870-2734-4873-5087.description:
Use Cyberdrive Awakener to make Eternity Vessel a creature.
Cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
The Ozolith triggers, putting a number of charge counters on itself equal to the charge counters that were on Eternity Vessel.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving all counters from it onto Darksteel Reactor.
Darksteel Reactor triggers, causing you to win the game.

4149-4599-4871-6019-6968.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating six 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing a Zombie token and Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When the Zombie and Ghoulcaller Gisa die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Scourge of Nel Toth.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping Scourge of Nel Toth and four other Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller GIsa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4529-4875-5256-5659.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing God-Eternal Bontu.
When God-Eternal Bontu dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to God-Eternal Bontu's power, which will cause you to mill God-Eternal Bontu.
As God-Eternal Bontu is a Lhurgoyf due to Conspiracy, Disa's first ability triggers, returning God-Eternal Bontu from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1409-5007.description:
Activate Morselhoarder by paying {1}{U}, blinking it. Morselhoarder will enter with two -1/-1 counters on it due to its ability.
When Morselhoarder enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Morselhoarder.
Activate Morselhoarder twice by removing two -1/-1 counters from it, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

4518-4986-6798--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Kor Skyfisher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Kor Skyfisher
Repeat.
4518-4986-6798--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

730-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Emeria Angel triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1414-3499.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1978-2392-3151.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Elves.

129-5137-5268.description:
Activate Morphling by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Morphling by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
129-5137-5268.notes: Once you have infinite {U}, you can instead tap for other colors of mana. Notably, you can tap for {G} to use Kinnan's ability.

3000-5189-5641.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3000-5189-5641.description:
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

325-602-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
325-602-6282.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one more card in hand than your maximum hand size.
325-602-6282.description:
Proceed to your cleanup step, causing you to discard cards down to your maximum hand size.
Toluz's second ability triggers for each card discarded.
Resolve the first trigger, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Feast of Sanity triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2 as applicable for each remaining trigger.
Discard cards down until your maximum hand size, as the cleanup step is still onging.
Repeat from step 2.

957-1329-2707-6504.description:
If Conjurer's Bauble is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Conjurer's Bauble. Then, cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Time Stretch onto the bottom of your library from your graveyard, and then causing you to draw Time Stretch from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat each other turn.

1170-4779-5006--23.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using Lurrus this turn.
1170-4779-5006--23.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing the artifact cast in step 1.
Repeat.

360-440-1339-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
360-440-1339-5231.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

710-2511-5617.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

813-2292-2701-5117.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Undying Malice by paying {B}, targeting Scholar of the Ages.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages dies, it triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Undying Malice and Dark Ritual to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1381-2938-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hypnotic Siren, adding {U}.
When Hypnotic Siren dies, Mortuary and Ashiok's Reaper trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Hypnotic Siren on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Ashiok's Render trigger, causing you to draw Hypnotic Siren from your library.
Cast Hypnotic Siren by paying {U}.
Repeat.

674-1308-1563-2206-5270.description:
Cast Gingerbrute by paying {1}.
When Gingerbrute enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Food tokens.
Activate the two Foods by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Gingerbrute and the two Foods, returning Syr Ginger to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Syr Ginger by paying {2}.
When Syr Ginger enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Food tokens.
Activate the two Food tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Syr Ginger and the two Foods, returning Gingerbrute to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

619-1348-2179-3206-4806.notablePrerequisites: Manascape Refractor does not have summoning sickness.
619-1348-2179-3206-4806.description:
Activate Manascape Refractor using Blinkmoth Nexus' second ability by paying {1}.
Kurkesh triggers, choose not to pay.
Resolve the Manascape Refractor ability, causing it to become a 1/1 Blinkmoth artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Manascape Refractor as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Maze of Ith by tapping it, untapping Manascape Refractor.
Activate Manascape Refractor using Maze of Ith's ability by tapping it, targeting itself.
Kurkesh triggers, causing you to pay {R} to copy Manascape Refractor's ability, targeting Manascape Refractor.
Resolve the copy of Manascape Refractor's ability, untapping it.
Activate Manascape Refractor using Dormant Volcano's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{R}.
Resolve the original Manascape Refractor ability from step 6, untapping it.
Repeat from step 6.

109-4101-5195.description:
Cast Pair o' Dice Lost by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Fork by paying {R}{R}, targeting Pair o' Dice Lost.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Fork, copying Pair o' Dice Lost.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Pair o' Dice Lost, causing you to roll two d6 and return Fork and any other applicable card(s) to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.

628-2290-2292.notablePrerequisites: Spike Feeder has no +1/+1 counters on it.
628-2290-2292.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Spike Feeder.
Spike Feeder's undying ability triggers, returning itself to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to gain six life.
Repeat.

1987-2427-3227.notablePrerequisites: You control an artifact or land that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce {U}.
1987-2427-3227.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Scrivener and your untapped source, blinking them both.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Tap your untapped blue source for {U}.
Repeat.

662-4096-4853-5167.notablePrerequisites: Goblin Welder does not have summoning sickness.
662-4096-4853-5167.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Goblin Welder to become an artifact in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, sacrificing Dross Scorpion and returning Esper Sojourners from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Goblin Welder.
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, sacrificing Esper Sojourners and returning Dross Scorpion from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Esper Sojourners triggers, untapping Goblin Welder.
Repeat from step 2.
